# Deck Requirements Quality Checklist: Build Local Anki Deck

**Purpose**: Review whether the feature requirements are complete, clear, internally consistent,
measurable, and resistant to identity, duplication, vocabulary-integrity, and card-direction errors
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the requirements explicit that every source concept produces exactly one note and
  exactly one card, with no exception for language, cue type, tags, or media? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-016]
- [x] CHK002 Are separate Indonesian and Malaysian cards, reverse cards, and independently scheduled
  language directions all explicitly prohibited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK003 Are the permanent concept identity and each mutable value enumerated completely enough
  to prevent English, Indonesian, Malaysian, image, tags, row order, or styling from entering note
  identity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, SC-002]
- [x] CHK004 Are stable deck identity, note-model identity, note GUID, field schema, and template
  count all covered as distinct compatibility requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015–FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 Are all six TSV columns documented, including which column values are mandatory and
  which may be empty? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements complete for preserving six-digit IDs as strings, including leading
  zeroes and rejection of non-ASCII digits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements present for both valid front-cue states—English fallback and image
  replacement—and for retaining English in source data in either state? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-021–FR-023]
- [x] CHK008 Are the back-card requirements complete for cue context, explicit language labels, and
  simultaneous disclosure of both Indonesian and Malaysian answers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK009 Are vocabulary-integrity requirements explicit that the pipeline may neither generate
  missing content nor translate, infer, normalize, rewrite, or silently correct reviewed values?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 Are validation requirements documented for every mandated invalid-input category and
  for the rule that validation precedes any package generation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 Is “one semantic vocabulary concept” defined clearly enough to prevent a single row
  from being interpreted as multiple notes or cards? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK012 Is the six-ASCII-digit ID grammar unambiguous about length, allowed characters,
  uniqueness, whitespace, and preservation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003–FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is “derived deterministically from only the permanent concept ID” precise enough to
  exclude default or content-derived GUID behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]
- [x] CHK014 Is the meaning of “stable” differentiated for deck ID, model ID, GUID, schema, template,
  package bytes, and semantic package content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015–FR-020]
- [x] CHK015 Is “prominently” displaying the English cue objectively defined or paired with a
  measurable visual criterion? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK016 Is an image considered available only after successful media validation, so cue
  fallback behavior cannot be interpreted differently for missing or unsafe references? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-011, FR-023]
- [x] CHK017 Is “clearly label and display” defined sufficiently to distinguish each language answer
  and prevent an unlabeled combined answer? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK018 Are “when continued checking is safe” and “when those values can be determined” bounded
  clearly enough for consistent validation-error aggregation and diagnostics? [Ambiguity, Spec
  §FR-008–FR-009]
- [x] CHK019 Is “semantically equivalent” defined with an explicit comparison boundary that separates
  stable meaning from permitted package metadata variation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK020 Is “supported Anki update behavior” scoped to identifiable client versions, settings,
  and user-controlled import choices? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020, SC-007, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK021 Are the one-note/one-card and single-review-direction rules mutually consistent across
  user stories, functional requirements, key entities, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec
  §User Stories 1 and 3, FR-016, FR-025, SC-001]
- [x] CHK022 Are mutable-content examples consistent everywhere with the rule that GUID identity uses
  only the concept ID? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, FR-017, SC-002]
- [x] CHK023 Are English/image cue rules consistent between front acceptance scenarios, functional
  requirements, back behavior, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories 1 and 4,
  FR-021–FR-024, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Are the required TSV schema and optional-value rules consistent between functional
  requirements, key entities, edge cases, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002–FR-006, Key
  Entities, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 Is `dist/myid-anki.apkg` defined consistently as the sole canonical output path across
  the specification, plan, data model, contracts, quickstart, and task requirements? [Consistency,
  Spec §FR-014 and Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Is media collision behavior consistently defined as Unicode-case-folded comparison of
  packaged basenames, including complete conflict reporting and the exact same-resolved-file reuse
  exception? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033; Contract §Vocabulary TSV/Image Rules]
- [x] CHK027 Are removal requirements consistent that a missing source concept is omitted from a new
  package but does not request deletion from an existing learner collection? [Consistency, Spec
  §User Story 3, FR-032]
- [x] CHK028 Are desktop/mobile first-import, offline, approximately 320 CSS-pixel readability, and
  no-JavaScript requirements consistent across acceptance scenarios, functional requirements,
  contracts, and measurable outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, FR-027–FR-028, FR-034,
  SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK029 Can the exactly-one-note-and-card invariant be measured for every source concept without
  relying on subjective interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK030 Does stable-identity acceptance cover every mutable field and presentation change named
  by the requirements, rather than only identical rebuilds? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK031 Does the zero-duplicate re-import criterion define the starting collection state,
  imported versions, unchanged ID set, and applicable Anki update setting? [Acceptance Criteria,
  Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK032 Is mobile readability objectively assessable at viewport widths of at least 320 CSS
  pixels, including wrapping long values, constraining images, and requiring no horizontal scroll,
  custom zoom, or interaction? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027, SC-005]
- [x] CHK033 Is validation success defined quantitatively for every required invalid-input category
  and every diagnosable row or concept? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario and Failure Coverage

- [x] CHK034 Are primary requirements complete for edit, validate, build, import, study, modify,
  rebuild, and re-import stages of the stated local workflow? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–5]
- [x] CHK035 Are alternate requirements complete for concepts with no image, one image, shared media,
  empty tags, reordered rows, and changed mutable content? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK036 Are exception requirements complete for malformed TSV, invalid UTF-8, blank required
  values, duplicate IDs, unsafe media, missing media, media collisions, and empty datasets?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-003–FR-013, FR-033]
- [x] CHK037 Are recovery requirements explicit that validation completes before temporary package
  creation and that failure returns nonzero without creating, replacing, truncating, or partially
  writing the final artifact while leaving prior output byte-for-byte unchanged? [Coverage,
  Recovery, Spec §FR-012–FR-013, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Are rapid consecutive builds required to advance Anki note modification metadata
  strictly, including in the same wall-clock second, without affecting GUID identity or sleeping?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-035, SC-008]
- [x] CHK039 Are collection behavior and stable GUID requirements explicit when a removed concept is
  later reintroduced with the same permanent ID, including existing and independently deleted notes?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-036, SC-009]

## Media Safety and Boundary Quality

- [x] CHK040 Are safe-relative-path requirements explicit for absolute paths, parent traversal,
  symlink escape, directories, missing files, remote URLs, and platform-specific separators?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK041 Is containment defined against the resolved media directory and resolved target rather
  than only the source path text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK042 Are the requirements clear that image references remain source-controlled paths while
  packaged media naming may differ from repository structure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, FR-026]
- [x] CHK043 Are requirements documented for media names containing spaces, non-ASCII characters,
  case variants, and shared references? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-026, FR-033]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and V1 Boundaries

- [x] CHK044 Are responsibilities divided clearly between project-controlled identity guarantees
  and Anki-client-controlled import/update decisions? [Dependency, Spec §FR-020, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK045 Must acceptance record the Anki Desktop and official mobile client names and versions,
  operating systems, and import settings so the compatibility target is reproducible? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-034, SC-005, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK046 Are offline requirements clear that environment setup may need dependencies while normal
  validation, generation, import, and study require no network service? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027–FR-028]
- [x] CHK047 Are V1 exclusions explicit and consistent for translation, generated vocabulary, image
  acquisition or optimization, audio, examples, publishing, synchronization, UI, databases,
  authentication, and cloud services? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK048 Are scope exclusions and vocabulary-integrity rules jointly sufficient to prevent
  illustrative rows, synthetic fixtures, or AI output from silently becoming authoritative
  vocabulary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-007, Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK049 Are compatibility-sensitive future changes—IDs, GUID rules, deck/model identity, fields,
  schemas, or template count—required to receive explicit impact and migration analysis? [Gap,
  Constitution §VI and Governance]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
